Project context describes observational-memory for pi: event-driven orchestrator with default-OFF per-session `/om` gate, parallel subprocess observers committing branch-local `om.*` ledger entries, deterministic compaction projection, and a single consolidator promoting older observations into durable memory. Worker sessions are ordinary recorded global pi sessions; `.memory/.runs/` carries transient IPC.
